mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_log (product_detail_id, product_id, order_number, change_type, change_quantity, before_stock, after_stock, gmt_created) VALUES (#{productDetailId}, #{productId}, #{orderNumber}, #{changeType}, #{changeQuantity}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{gmtCreated})
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_detail_id, product_id, order_number, change_type, change_quantity, before_stock, after_stock, gmt_created FROM stock_log WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber} ORDER BY id ASC
